transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hello, doctor. My family keeps telling me everything is normal, but I’m absolutely convinced they’re secretly working together behind my back. I just can't shake this belief, no matter what they show me to try and prove me wrong.
Have you noticed any other unusual experiences, like hearing voices or believing that someone is controlling your thoughts or actions, or is it mainly this one belief about your family?

No, nothing like that at all—I don't hear voices or have my thoughts controlled, and everything else in my life is completely normal. My concern is entirely about my ex-husband, the kids, and their lawyer secretly plotting to cut me out of the family decisions and my parents' property. They pretend to include me, but I know what they are really planning behind my back.
Has this belief caused any major changes in your mood, sleep, work, or daily functioning, or does it stay limited to this one issue?

My work and volunteering are completely unaffected; I still manage my office team and do my shifts at the senior center just fine. However, it has heavily damaged my family life because I avoid family gatherings and get into tense arguments with my ex-husband and kids. I'm just constantly on edge around them, which has really strained our relationships.
How long have you been having this belief about your family plotting against you? Has it been present for at least 1 month, or longer?

This has been going on for about eleven months now, ever since we started dealing with selling my parents' house and sorting out their papers. That's when I first realized they were coordinating behind my back to cut me out, and it has been constant ever since.
Besides this belief about your family plotting against you, have you had any other fixed beliefs that others say are untrue, such as being followed, poisoned, cheated, or having special powers?

No, I don't have any beliefs like that at all; I've never felt like I was being followed, poisoned, or had any special powers. My only concern is strictly about my ex-husband, the kids, and their lawyer coordinating behind my back to cut me out of the family decisions and my parents' property. That is the only thing I am certain is happening.
Has this belief ever involved anything beyond your family and the property dispute, such as other people, organizations, or situations, or has it stayed limited to this one issue?

No, it is strictly limited to my ex-husband, my kids, and the lawyer involved in the property. I don't feel this way about anyone else at all, like my boss, my coworkers, or the people at the senior center where I volunteer. My work and volunteer life remain completely normal and unaffected by any of this.
Have you had any periods of feeling unusually energized or depressed, or any hallucinations or other strange experiences outside this belief?

No, I haven't had any periods of feeling unusually high or low, nor have I ever heard or seen things that aren't there. My focus is entirely on the situation with my family and the property, and everything else with my mood and senses is completely normal.
Has this belief ever spread to other areas of your life, or has it stayed strictly limited to your ex-husband, children, and the property dispute?

No, it has stayed strictly limited to my ex-husband, the kids, and that lawyer regarding the family property. It hasn't spread to any other areas of my life at all. I still run my office team at work and do my volunteer shifts at the senior center without any of these thoughts or issues.
Has this belief stayed limited to your family and the property dispute, or has it ever expanded to involve other people or situations in your life?

No, it has never expanded to anyone or anything else; it is strictly limited to my ex-husband, my kids, and the lawyer. Outside of them, my life is completely normal, and I still manage my office team and volunteer at the senior center without any issues. It has absolutely nothing to do with other people or situations.
Have you ever had any hallucinations, disorganized thoughts, or other unusual experiences outside of this fixed belief, even briefly?

No, I have never had any hallucinations, disorganized thoughts, or any other unusual experiences like that. My mind is completely clear, and this issue with my family is the only thing I am concerned about.
Has this belief ever been part of a larger pattern of unusual beliefs or suspiciousness in other areas of your life, or has it stayed completely limited to this family and property situation?

No, there is absolutely no pattern of this in other areas of my life; it is completely limited to my family and the property. I get along great with my office team at work and the people at the senior center, and I've never felt suspicious of them. This tension and suspicion only happen when I have to deal with my ex-husband, the kids, and that paperwork.
Have you ever believed that your family or others are trying to harm you in ways beyond the property dispute, or is the belief strictly limited to that one situation?

No, it is strictly limited to them trying to cut me out of the property sale and family decisions, and I don't believe they are trying to harm me in any other way. I also don't feel this way about anyone else, like my boss, coworkers, or the people at the senior center. Outside of these family arguments, my daily life and work are completely normal.

Has this belief ever been limited to just your family and the property dispute, or have you also believed there was some broader conspiracy or ongoing surveillance involving other people or organizations?

No, there is absolutely no broader conspiracy or surveillance, and I don't think the government or any other organizations are involved at all. This is strictly between me, my ex-husband, the kids, and that lawyer. I get along perfectly fine with my coworkers and the people at the senior center without any suspicions whatsoever.

How old were you when these suspicious beliefs first started, and have you ever had a long-standing pattern of being very suspicious or distrustful of other people before this family/property situation?

I am currently 59, and these beliefs started about eleven months ago when I was 58. Before this whole situation with my parents' house and the paperwork, I was never a suspicious or distrustful person at all. This is a completely new issue for me that only began with this specific family dispute.

Before this family/property dispute started, had you ever been unusually suspicious, mistrustful, or prone to believing others were against you for a long time? Or did this begin only with this situation?

No, this began strictly with this situation. Before the dispute over my parents' house started eleven months ago, I never had these kinds of suspicious or mistrustful thoughts about my family or anyone else. This is completely new for me.
Did this belief start after a clearly stressful event or family conflict, and has it stayed focused only on that situation without spreading to other areas of your life?

Yes, it started eleven months ago during that highly stressful conflict over selling my parents' house and sorting out the paperwork. Since then, it has stayed entirely focused on my ex-husband and children's actions regarding family matters, while my work running my office team and my volunteer shifts at the senior center remain completely unaffected and normal.
Did these beliefs begin only after the family property conflict, and do they ever spread beyond that one situation to other areas of your life?

Yes, they started about eleven months ago, triggered specifically by the stressful arguments over selling my parents' house and the paperwork in Mexico. These suspicions have never spread to other areas of my life, so I still manage my office team and volunteer at the senior center without any issues. However, the focus remains entirely on my ex-husband and children, making any interaction with them incredibly tense and exhausting.
Do you have any other long-standing suspicious or paranoid beliefs outside this family/property dispute, or has this been the only fixed belief you’ve ever had?

This is absolutely the only issue I have ever had, and I don't have any other suspicious or paranoid beliefs about other people or situations. Everything is completely normal with my boss, coworkers, and the people at the senior center. My concern is strictly and specifically about my ex-husband, my children, and the conspiracy to cut me out of my parents' house.

Is there any chance that your concern about your ex-husband and children could be based on a real family conflict or legal dispute that others would also see as plausible, rather than a fixed belief that they are plotting against you?

There is definitely a real dispute over my parents' house and the legal paperwork in Mexico, but this is not just a normal family disagreement. My ex-husband, the kids, and their lawyer are absolutely coordinating behind my back to cut me out of all the decisions. It is not a misunderstanding at all; their plot to push me out is very real, no matter what anyone else says.
Do you think there is any chance this could be a misunderstanding or an exaggeration of a real family/legal conflict, or are you completely certain it is a deliberate plot against you?

I understand that to an outsider, this might just look like a typical family disagreement or a misunderstanding over legal paperwork. However, I am completely certain that they are deliberately coordinating against me. No matter what documents or reassurances they show me, it is entirely obvious that they are hiding their true plans to cut me out.
Do you think there is any chance this could be a misunderstanding or an exaggeration of a real family/legal conflict, or are you completely certain it is a deliberate plot against you?

I know it looks like a normal disagreement to everyone else, but I am absolutely certain this is a deliberate plot to exclude me. It is incredibly frustrating when they show me legal papers and emails to "prove" otherwise, because I know they are just hiding their real coordination. There is no doubt in my mind that they are working together behind my back.

Is your belief only about a real family/legal dispute that could be partly understandable, or do you believe there is a clearly false, fixed plot against you that others would say is not supported by the facts?

I know the dispute started over real legal documents and selling my parents' house, but I firmly believe there is a coordinated, hidden plot against me. It is incredibly frustrating that my sister, my priest, and the kids keep telling me everything is normal and unsupported by facts, because I simply cannot shake the conviction that they are secretly working behind my back.
Did this belief start only as an understandable reaction to the real family/legal dispute, or do you believe it is clearly a false, fixed conspiracy that is not supported by the facts?

I absolutely do not believe this is some false conspiracy; what is happening is very real. Although it started during the actual dispute over my parents' house, I am completely convinced they are hiding their true plans. Even when they show me legal papers or emails to try and prove otherwise, I know they are secretly working behind my back.
Do you think there is any chance this could be a misunderstanding or a real family/legal conflict that got worse, or are you completely certain it is a false, fixed plot against you?

I understand why others might see this as just a standard legal conflict or a misunderstanding that got out of hand. But I am completely certain there is a coordinated effort against me, and no amount of papers or emails they show me can change how real this plot feels. It is incredibly exhausting to live with this constant tension, but I simply cannot ignore what is happening.
Did this belief begin as a reaction to a real family/legal dispute that could be partly understandable, or do you feel it is a clearly false fixed belief that goes beyond what the facts support?

Yes, this absolutely started with a very real and stressful dispute over selling my parents' house, handling the legal paperwork in Mexico, and dividing their belongings. However, I do not believe my suspicion is false or imaginary at all; to me, it feels completely real and justified based on how they've behaved, even if they keep insisting everything is normal.

Do you think your concern is mainly an understandable reaction to a real family/legal conflict, or are you completely certain that there is a false, fixed plot against you that goes beyond what the facts support?

To me, this is not a false belief at all; it is a very real, deliberate plot based on how they have been acting. Even though they show me papers and insist everything is normal, it is completely obvious to me that they are hiding their true plans. I am absolutely certain they are coordinating behind my back to cut me out.

Can you see any possibility that this could be an understandable reaction to a real family/legal conflict, or are you completely certain it is a false, fixed belief that others would say is not supported by the facts?

There is certainly a real conflict over my parents' house and the legal documents, but I am absolutely certain they are coordinating against me. Even though they claim everything is normal and try to show me papers, I know they are hiding the real plan. It isn't some false belief; to me, it is completely real.
Was this belief a reasonable reaction to a real family or legal dispute, or do you believe it is a clearly false, fixed conviction that goes beyond what the facts support?

This is not a false conviction at all; it is a very real and obvious plot to exclude me. While the dispute over my parents' house is real, I am absolutely certain my ex-husband, children, and their lawyer are actively working behind my back, and the documents they show me are just a cover-up to hide their true plans.

Do you think your concern is mainly an understandable reaction to a real family/legal conflict, or are you completely certain that there is a false, fixed plot against you that goes beyond what the facts support?

I am completely certain that this is a deliberate plot against me, not some imaginary belief. While the conflict over my parents' house is real, my ex-husband and the kids are absolutely coordinating behind my back to cut me out. All the papers and emails they show me are just a cover-up to hide what they are really planning.

Do you think your concern is mainly an understandable reaction to a real family or legal dispute, or are you completely certain that there is a false, fixed plot against you that goes beyond what the facts support?

I am absolutely certain this is a coordinated plot against me, not some overreaction to a normal family disagreement. Even though they keep showing me emails and papers to prove everything is fine, I know they are just using those to hide their true plan to cut me out. There is no doubt in my mind that this is really happening.
